summary: AI research agents can propose, execute, and improve programs that solve machine learning tasks. However, executing each candidate program requires training and evaluating ML models, limiting how many candidates an agent can explore at each step.
takeaways: However, executing each candidate program requires training and evaluating ML models, limiting how many candidates an agent can explore at each step.
Because a prediction costs one inference call rather than a training run, MLE-World makes test time scaling (TTS) affordable for these agents.
MLE-World guided TTS achieves up to 22.1% higher observed mean performance than the agent without a world model, with less real execution.
